issue_name: Playlist playback and song selection limits
description: Users object to limits on song selection and playlist playback, including shuffle behavior and controls that they say require Premium.
Users report frequent or intrusive ads interrupting music playback, including complaints that an ad-free option still includes ads.

issue_name: Premium required for song choice and controls
description: Reviewers say free-plan users are being asked to upgrade to Premium to play chosen songs or use song controls such as seeking and changing tracks.
Users say many features or basic use now require Premium, making the free version feel too limited.
Users say they cannot log in to their account, without identifying a specific sign-in method or error.
Users say premium prompts and paywalls make the app feel increasingly unusable or irritating.

issue_name: Songs or albums missing from catalog
description: Users report that songs or complete albums, including local artists' releases, are missing or cannot be found in the catalog.

issue_name: Recent updates removed features or worsened the interface
description: Users say recent updates changed the interface or removed basic features and request restoration of the previous experience.
Playback unexpectedly pauses or stops during or between songs and may require restarting playback or the app.
Reviews mainly report instability, crashes, lag, or slow startup when using the app.
Lyrics fail to appear or load for songs where users expect them to be available.

issue_name: Downloaded tracks disappear or fail offline
description: Downloaded tracks may disappear, fail to play offline, or repeatedly require downloading again.
Users report being unable to log in or regain access to their accounts and saved music.
Downloaded music sometimes fails to appear or play offline, or the app incorrectly reports that the user is offline.
Customers report difficulty reaching support or getting useful, safe help to resolve app problems.
